caption:
Rs 10 crore out. Rs 2.4 crore in.

Rajasthan Royals and Lucknow Super Giants are reportedly in talks on a multi-player trade before IPL 2027 retentions, Cricbuzz reports: Mohammed Shami (Rs 10 crore) to RR, Sam Curran (Rs 2.4 crore) to LSG, with spinner Manimaran Siddharth (Rs 75 lakh) possibly heading to RR as well. Nothing is signed; the paperwork is reportedly pending.

Why RR want it: an experienced Indian new-ball bowler (145 IPL wickets) next to Jofra Archer.
Why LSG want it: Curran adds batting depth, knows director of cricket Tom Moody, and the swap frees purse room.
The catch: Shami went at an economy of 9 in IPL 2026, Curran didn't play a game for RR after an injury, and he's reportedly asking for a revised fee.

Retention lists are due November 17. The mini-auction is in Goa on December 16.
